## What this is

`gtskill` is a small, testable evaluation harness that lets a language
model produce a formatted
[Great Tables](https://posit-dev.github.io/great-tables/) table from a
CSV and a natural-language prompt. It is built around one short "skill"
the agent loads at runtime — everything else (the runner, the judge,
the comparator) is scaffolding for engineering and measuring that
skill.
